releaseNotes.headline: Your AI workspace, together
releaseNotes.summary: Open usAIge to one Overview for AI usage, local resources, and repository work. Compact tool cards, a larger sailing ocean, and a separate cleanup popup keep the workspace clear while work continues.

highlights.title: One main Overview
highlights.detail: On macOS 14 and later, launching usAIge or clicking its Dock icon opens the main window. See equal-size AI usage cards, the complete memory and storage ocean, and branches and worktrees together. Status tabs start on All, and Rescan is beside the branch heading.

highlights.title: Cleanup stays steady
highlights.detail: Review and Clear explains how much storage can be freed. Follow progress and results in a popup, hide it while cleanup continues, or stop after the current item. Closing and reopening the main window keeps the operation and its result available. Restore cleared branches and folders from the result or Recently Deleted.

highlights.title: Settings in the navigator
highlights.detail: Jump to Resources or Branches and Worktrees from the sidebar. Settings stays at the bottom, with an aligned update reminder above it. Manage tools, add a repository folder, and read workspace data again from the Settings page.

highlights.title: A roomier ocean and familiar shortcuts
highlights.detail: The sailing ocean gives the ship more room, with Weather beside the ship selector. Use Command-N or Command-0 for the main window, Command-1 for branches, Command-2 for Memory, Command-3 for Storage, Command-R to refresh, and Command-comma for Settings.
